title: Create Entire Podcasts From Your Content in Seconds With This Free AI Tool
description:
NotebookLM podcast generator explained — how to paste any document, script, PDF, or video into NotebookLM and get a full human-sounding AI podcast with two hosts in under a minute for free.

NotebookLM is a free Google tool that turns any document into a full podcast with two AI hosts who discuss it like a real conversation. I pasted the exact script Claude wrote for this video into NotebookLM and got a complete human-sounding podcast out of it in under a minute. You can do the same with any content you already have, a PDF, a video, a website, a script, anything. The podcast snippet you hear at the start of this Short is the real output. This is not a demonstration. It is the actual result.

In this video:
→ A real NotebookLM AI podcast snippet generated from the script for this video
→ How to paste any document into NotebookLM and generate a full podcast instantly
→ Why the two AI hosts sound completely human and not robotic
→ How to repurpose any content you already have into a full podcast for free
→ Where to try NotebookLM right now at no cost
